cycles.title: The Older Inhabited World
cycles.eyebrow: Earlier powers, practiced institutions, and the generations before Nell.

These are already inhabited societies with their own prior generations, not beginnings assigned by the presence of dragons, elves or crowns. Isolated practitioners and privately retained workings lead into an ordinary-looking modern reach. Nell and Bash's low-magic home is its final fixed landmark; Ravel keeps its unresolved place.

leave-the-names.note: A caravan trades with an operator who still knows how Cerdovan's civic dissolution engine works. the-lights-beyond.note: Five centuries of enforced separation have hidden an inhabited orc city only two ridges away. the-city-of-eleven-foundations.note: Eleven contemporaneous districts share one river basin and service ring. rooms-before-sunrise.note: A six-hundred-lease reef tower depends on maintained living circulation. the-unfixed-song.note: A sailing city maintains hulls, gardens, forges and physical soundings while a new climate archive begins operating. laughing-clouds.note: A civic repair festival supports reused materials, engineers, shared tools and public play. kite-letters-below.note: The station teaches that the last ground habitats failed 812 years earlier, but its present picture of an empty surface is contradicted by living tenders. apes-in-orbit.note: A surface polity with hatcheries, trams, waterworks and technical observers lives beneath human stations using an old empty-basin target. the-shadow-that-nested.note: An ancient sunshade shelters ordinary organisms above inhabited, technically capable surface grids. A tug crew's repair preserves both nests and some power; the structure's lost builders do not make the whole present a ruin.

the-star-that-followed-the-bells.note: A pastoral settlement's inherited bell practices help a wounded vessel coordinate with three independent satellites and reach a local orbit. the-sky-remembers-us-return.note: Ordinary light carries the extinction's final image across ages of perfect material zero. The first bilateral link between Dalo and Keshen begins genuinely new magic; no old root is restored, and the earlier scenes do not share the link's date.

there-goes-your-name.note: A sheepfold, trained dog and household calling practice sustain a pastoral livelihood. Its active name working can belong on either side of the Long Dark; this later commons placement is proposed, not proof of the new system's first generation.

ultimate-evil-dog.note: Proposed in Cycle IV's developed material societies: Brightguard's engineered harness supplies lifting and flight, while a charged exchange device makes Maledict's crime possible. life-with-a-girlfriend-with-shrinking-po.note: Proposed in the mature mixed world before extinction: bodily ability, ordinary appliances, building services and professional maintenance are all already in use. Luz's four-year partnership and practiced limits do not belong automatically with other transformation stories. Her twenty-four-minute maximum applies below half height, and safe cycles need at least six hours between them. No proximity to Faris's lifetime is implied.

where-sleep-takes-you.note: Four years of repair-shop history are packed into storage after its closure. Cira clears client property, calibrated tools and records under a fixed contractor deadline. This supports the selected post-return context without making her a member of a shared power-care institution or dating her condition's origin.

lightning-carries-one.note: Hazel has used solo crossings for six months when she first carries Tobin; eight outside years later they revisit changed streets by bus and on foot. Clinics have measured some bodily change, but her journey model remains incomplete and there is no demonstrated public hero organization. This proposed post-return history concerns a family's long aftermath, not a stage of the profession in Held Together or the origin of a common transport network.

when-the-needle-finds-you.note: A functioning city's recovery work, clinics, transport and radio audience surround a pirate broadcaster's coercion. Olt has supplied blood and concealed facts; a survivor redirects that practice toward him, while the Jester uses a ledger and changing broadcasts to shape people's choices. The eye's forecasts remain revisable. This proposed later active-magical setting establishes neither descent from older royal forecasts nor the origin or wider reach of the faculty.

what-turned-eighteen.note: Arlon's community expects varied changes at eighteen; family preparation, a cousin's work and Jaro's amended records show an established local custom. The first afternoon in nine bodies is personal adaptation within that continuing society. A mature post-return position is proposed, but the custom's age, population origin and relation to other cities remain unknown.

the-first-kingdom-was-late-on-taxes.note: The receiving society has already excavated Kettlebridge's surroundings for generations before the intact village arrives from millions of years earlier. Translation tools, mechanized excavation, media, rival heritage claims and temporary adjudication support a proposed late receiving frame. First Kingdom is the future's interpretation, not an established founding event. Neither departure's cycle nor arrival's absolute date is known.

the-upward-rain.note: Placed provisionally in the mature post-return world: an inhabited coast has harbor infrastructure, route traditions, mast records, scientific fieldwork and limited shore rescue. The expedition depends on that continuing society. Namarra's repair layers belong to its undated local past; investigating them does not make this the latest civilization. The sea's upward motion has no established origin or system, and an earlier magical age remains an alternative.

the-hoarders-house.note: A museum follows sale records into a crowded household where salvage knowledge, uncertain ownership and blocked access already matter. An eleven-year record dates the marker-containing lot, while the four objects' origins and other acquisition histories remain incomplete. Emergency containment and limited clearance follow observed local effects. The active seed's biology and connection to any older magic remain unknown; this proposed later placement does not establish survival of an extinct system.

the-first-wound.note: A tram incident brings an already long-lived client to a living memory specialist. His memories show a refuge 612 years earlier and a factory eighty-three years earlier, each already operating in its own crisis; they do not identify one civilization progressing into the present clinic. His estimated age is about twenty-five thousand years, with gaps. The selected post-return session does not date his earliest battle or establish the source of his longevity.

tenth-world-lesson.note: This proposed position immediately before Nell's home concerns Ryo's ordinary apartment frame, not the coordinates of his assignments. Both stories depart from a familiar life into histories their travelers cannot date. Nine years for Eiren and considerably more for Ryo do not determine elapsed time at home; the storm society and other destinations stay unplaced relative to the material sequence.

a-knock-in-someone-elses-sleep: An enclosed living being harms adult quarry workers through overwhelming contact, then gradually learns a smaller approach to sleeping children.

Sixty years later, Cleo, nine, can remake a message for her known sleeping neighbor; she is not Garnet's descendant.
The being learns to answer Cleo's own play as well as its old friendship. A reply reaches Garnet without renewed direct adult contact.
The being remains physically enclosed. Cleo's approaching departure leaves later contact uncertain.
the-lights-beyond: The Great Wall keeps one population isolated for five hundred years
Scouts enter a neighboring city with electricity, trams and seaplanes
Both societies remain inhabited during the same journey
where-the-white-elk-went: A hall becomes farm walls; the walls disappear into an orchard.
Oaks grow through the orchard; a later road bends around them and vanishes beneath beech.
For a long time, a buried foundation kept the younger woodland’s roots apart from Elderweald.
Following the elk, Avarra discovers that storm-broken masonry has already allowed the two woodlands to join.
the-morning-her-hand-moved: For a thousand years, ledgers describe settled life on a body whose death supposedly predates the towns.
Engineered cisterns, roads and registers support 5,281 residents of the inhabited hand.
The hand moves; old bracing fails and every resident is accounted for beyond the wrist.
Four counterweights close the ruined bridge; later slowing has several possible explanations.
Forearm gardens become a new settlement with revised routes, water rations and ongoing measurements.
a-crown-for-the-endless-fire: A working mine opens onto older chiseled passages and a bridge whose usual relief shutter has jammed after a tremor.
Uldek's first attempt closes the wrong relief path and worsens the load; Lemra's observations correct his diagnosis.
The return rope becomes two slings left under the bridge while controlled shutter adjustments restore a safer draft.
Lemra removes and caps the crown after the loads settle. They close the bridge and take the known service stair.
The damaged rib and spent equipment remain recorded for later work; the fire's origin is not discovered.
when-the-eagle-bowed: The custodial Eagle Queen refuses three warlords' demand for talonmail soldiers; they execute her and become competing crowns
A century later, the colony reaches Yavren and opens memories of her own former life, including a revenge plan against all three keeps
Changed paths, current horn codes and Pelka's local knowledge matter more than the queen's obsolete map
Yavren rejects the destruction of later towns and uses the old molting structure to free the colony while leaving a misleading royal husk
By the next dawn, the sisters leave with wounds and limited money; the crowns dispute the site while the eyries hold
tea-for-the-first-guest: The tower belongs to an older world of imperial duties, grain fleets and horse relays.
Centuries pass without a guest while the wizard maintains his threshold.
A present-day bookmender enters but cannot identify the empires his host remembers.
The visit ends without supplying a complete account of the outside world.
a-crown-of-quiet-hours: Twelve dragons maintain forty-seven royal masks and a fabricated ancestral cult across 218 years.

the-peace-they-could-sleep-through: Twelve dragons govern through one worshipped living guise for two centuries, forming an actual collective god.
Conflicting grain judgments force farmers and importers to confront the limits of a final royal answer.
The parties make a ninety-day agreement protecting seed while retaining bounded debt repayment and opening stock and cost records.
On day seventeen, a shortfall prompts a fourteen-hour meeting and an amended release schedule.
The dragons surrender royal and religious authority and leave for a refuge; continued private worship does not preserve their godhood.
Ordinary hearings continue under recallable chairs. After one year, the districts can keep, replace or discard the procedure; that review has not yet occurred.
the-unfinished-sunset: Aderi's keepers use a forty-three-minute solar extension as part of ordinary collective harvest work
Arveth refuses a grain seizure, overloads the harvest as a decoy, opposes Ilessa's blade and cuts the release braid before fleeing across the boundary

She returns to contest the blades; Ilessa's disarm maintains opposed pressure until separation while the keepers release the prepared vanes
Night proceeds without sudden aging or lost memories; Neth crosses freely, and Arveth works under supervision pending further judgment
voice-of-silence: After four years of design, Kethra demonstrates a voiced lattice within an existing college examination and caller practice.
A crack prompts a manual check and a reduced trial load; the old joint then fails under the occupied gallery's ordinary weight.
Dorram's Roofstay catches the roof but loads the exit column. Kethra maps a different rescue while honoring callers' waits and stops.

a-lock-on-the-inside: Kethra is already an archmage with a new seal; a mistreated apprentice has returned for three mornings seeking a place.

not-about-that: A family practice box has held the focus for years. Sarena teaches landings through the summer and spends three weeks obtaining permission for a supervised trial.

Brightguard's established routines expose the impersonation while her harness and civic channels answer Maledict's staged drone attack

After sunrise she wakes alive amid regional survivors, leaves Iverax's body and takes a burned man's hand while the wider world continues
the-weight-of-falling-up-rune-shoes: Nine Eaves already provides standard practice brooms, inspected harnesses, different course lanes and a professional survey roster. Juni has watched its flying practices for years.
On the assessment roof, Juni draws known wind curls on ordinary shoes and explains a one-use crown that stabilizes for exactly three powered breaths without steering.
Repeated microbursts wear the right curl during the stationary test. Juni sees the damage and refuses an offered repair pause with a one-point deduction.
A hard reverse brake destroys the right channel. More power to the surviving left jet increases the dangerous spin until Juni cuts it.
Juni redraws the right curl and crown while falling, then uses its three breaths to repair the left before resuming balanced thrust.

A controlled landing and an honest fault report earn an overall pass despite failed stationary control. Future long crossings require an explicit repair threshold and enough drawing to preserve a safety margin.
the-unfixed-face: Family practice and repeated client visits precede the closing day. During an earlier roof leak, Lucian moved two anonymous emergency fragments into his own active preset.
Public presets expire at noon and the remaining archive is due for sunset sterilization. Korrin has activated their father's old face without checking its carrier index.
Mekran arrives after a failed return begun three bells earlier on a train. His available communication channels change as the sisters search the archive.
The borrowed face and remembered script damage trust; Mekran stops their explanations and their family argument. His consent and the private carrier sequence identify his return fragment.
Releasing the fragment removes Korrin's mourning preset. Erisel then mistakes a pain flare for assent but stops before the next stage opens.
Directional hand pressure supports four further stages over eleven minutes. Treatment restores stable functions and the possibility of later revision, without forcing a remembered face.
At sunset the sisters finish the bounded archive closure. Mekran leaves with a remnant membrane; ordinary body revision continues in the city and in the sisters' own choices.
a-crown-in-the-bargain: An established kingdom has competing house votes, a regency during the king's incapacity, independent March jurisdiction and at least five years of storm-road records.

Tareya's earlier six-sheet articles omit a seventh sheet that would give the crown appointment and reserve powers. The first night still allows refusal, while flood reports show immediate local needs.

Lightning advances the rooftop registry's closure to forty-two minutes. A wet relay fails on the walk; a lamp tender repairs it. Alternate towers and signed vellum preserve routes for evidence without making light the law itself.

A demonstration exposes the strong filing's loss of independent representation. Tareya removes her ring; Osvan destroys that form and makes a witnessed sole placement before receiving any renewed agreement.

Separate relief terms commit paid engineers, draft teams, materials, grain and road access under bounded local direction. Unsafe orders may be refused, military billet rights are excluded, and debt does not attach to Tareya's title.

Tareya chooses a parallel household registration before the final bar expires. She requests the road and dispatch ledgers for breakfast; crews, repairs, repayment and the contested accession hearing remain ahead.
late-for-dinner: Nerava has been away for five months. An invading company loses support when two larger columns break; closed farms, burned bridges and missing envoys leave it seeking passage, with no bread for two days.
Late in the day, Rellan's market wagon is trapped at Plover's Cut. A guard's attempted resistance overturns it and injures him; the enemy raises the wagon so he can be freed.

Captain Cadren demands a road through Nerava's army in exchange for Rellan. Rellan cannot command his wife; his first offer of surrender and protection fails because it promises neither passage nor freedom.

Nerava is already with the legion nearby. Smoke on the western road, the wagon's absence at the east post and a patrol's discovery of the mule supply ordinary warning; the army closes the heights and both ends of the cut.

After fighting and casualties, soldiers begin surrendering independently of Cadren. Rellan raises his cloth and stands by explicit terms; Nerava accepts quarter, with custody possible and no revenge at the site.

The injured in both uniforms receive treatment before questioning, and prisoners go to separate watches. Nerava and Rellan reach home after dark; three thousand soldiers camp nearby while the wider war remains unresolved.
save-that-dragon: Imer built the quarry inspection route when Daziel was young and was later dismissed for opposing a raid on the sealed nest. Urrava authorized the armed survey for copper but concealed her part from Daziel.
Thelrax kills Daziel's husband at the nest and burns an occupied shelter twelve days later. Those separate harms precede the current hunt; their distance from the rescue night is not given.
Flooding blocks the queen's riders. Imer and Hovan use the old inspection route, ordinary keys, maintained ropes and a lamp to reach Daziel after six hours at her lever.

The royal writ changes who authorized the raid without erasing the dragon's attacks. Daziel's coupled spear and quarry brakes have created a lethal release sequence that worsening loads force Imer to revise.

One short fire burst scorches the net and injures Hovan. Daziel abandons the killing shot, dumps the spear and helps release the wing loads; Thelrax refuses treatment and takes the cleared downslope route.

At dawn the dragon clears the ridge with an injured throat; safe onward flight is unknown. Daziel ends pursuit and keeps the writ for her mother, while the three workers disable the remaining cocked mechanism before crews return.
the-five-minute-warranty: Before the blast, Director Vick rejects Kezli's pedestal-maintenance bid. The kiln explosion then breaks the crown gear, displaces the footing and buries the stairs, leaving forty people below.

Independent checks preserve the boiler, cages, cables and brakes. Replacement manufacture remains available on a scale of days; local tests support a temporary five-minute friction drive under four specified passenger loads.
The council requests the wage strongbox first. The extra journey would leave ten people below, so Vick signs and transmits a witnessed priority for all four passenger loads.
Operation begins at clutch engagement. Five colored cloth layers measure wear; a prepared pressure correction during the second load preserves the tested running conditions.
All forty people reach the upper landing. Bare iron triggers the declared shear, roller withdrawal, steam dump and brake sequence; the spent drive cannot be restarted within its warranty.

The lower station and strongbox are destroyed afterward. By noon Vick records her decisions, pays the emergency invoice from the upper reserve and commissions a permanent rebuild with independent inspectors. Construction and the inquiry remain ahead.
the-last-thing-i-could-fix: Hadrik already repairs magical objects powered by living people and has serviced the ordinary spillgate years earlier. Before arriving, Aven's first gate attempt injures a guide when the damaged harness pulls them into the danger.

Contact tests show no prediction or independent action: Aven's alarm and a protector's reflex supply the working after impact. A split assent rivet admits an unchosen response; blocking the outward hooks stops that pull.

Aven rejects the proposed two-hour conventional repair. Hadrik removes the coercive failure path, builds a conscious one-breath brace with three visible sacrificial rivets, and isolates an optional live consent ring.

The padded hard test spends the first rivet; light testing confirms that another person must actively join and can release the ring. At the damaged catwalk, Aven chooses Hadrik's rescue and spends the second rivet, straining their shoulder.

At the relief gate, the last brace cannot absorb sideways load. Hadrik discards the bypass shortcut, joins through the consent ring, and seats the ordinary locking wedge; the gate opens, the final rivet breaks and the braid fuses.

The lower town remains safe, but both workers need care and the harness is spent. Aven chooses ordinary mail, a crew and the right to refuse future work; Hadrik changes his sign next morning and describes more candid, collaborative later repairs.

connections.label: A profession reaching beyond the city
connections.note: Proposed regional connection: Lanternscrape receives three qualified surveyors with distinct instruments, while the municipal licensing story tests practice against pipe loads and source limits. These are compatible city-and-periphery conditions for circulating technical skills. A shared professional culture is plausible; the same guild, licensing law or exact date is not established.

connections.label: Practical flight in different cities
connections.note: Nine Eaves already has standard flight teaching, inspected equipment and survey work; Lowen’s city already has family instruction, delivery flight and agricultural rain hauling. These are established practices in their own settings, not a witnessed invention followed by adoption. Their chosen cycles remain different, but no route of transmission, institutional descent or mutual date is established by flying.

connections.label: Dragon service beyond hereditary alliance
connections.note: Proposed change in regional political economy: noble-dragon agreements exchange watch, rescue, nesting care and water access, while Qarsis hires a voluntarily migrant ice dragon for bounded municipal work among condensers and trade routes. The comparison supports a later reach where some dragon services travel as paid expertise. It does not claim all alliances ended or that Urumet descends from the earlier partners.

connections.label: Who controls the living heat?
connections.note: Proposed technical connection: Vantress combines living shadow, mineral heat, ceramic braces and ordinary pressure signals; the Glass-Sea branches combine dusk, living solar fire and physical heat-and-water conduits. Methods for sharing loads and limiting a capital’s draw could circulate between such societies. This proposes a field of civic engineering, not identical magic, named teachers or a proven order between the two regions.

connections.label: A family object in another age
connections.note: Tilda's nonliving focus and Lustre's living memories enter family life in different proposed ages. Their incomplete provenance is a comparison, not a common craft tradition, maker or inheritance of power.

connections.label: One job, bounded certification
connections.note: Pelmara receives a ten-day license for one observed faculty with continuing safety objections. The doorway apprentice documents four sound sets and their limits while independent qualification still awaits a master’s inspection. The comparison concerns the scope of professional permission; it supplies no common guild, historical transmission or order between those systems.

connections.label: What qualification actually permits
connections.note: Juni passes for rooftop-survey practice despite failing stationary control, subject to explicit repair margins. At Brightward, a proposed shield certification still depends on a live test that Mirelle refuses to supply. Both institutions constrain practical work, but neither establishes the other’s date, curriculum, ancestry or access to a common power.

connections.label: Bodies and their inherited explanations
connections.note: Mirrorglass House closes one family archive inside a continuing body-revision economy. A different caravan carries a copied survey of freight-adapted populations whose makers and method remain disputed. Unequal knowledge exists within that journey itself. The comparison identifies no seedglass ancestry, lost common industry or date between the societies.

connections.label: Living districts need a common city
connections.note: The reef tower and basin city depend on shared flow across occupied spaces. In one, improvised housing sustains excluded residents while endangering others; in the other, local protective boundaries magnify a common flood. The proposed nearby placement concerns established working infrastructure, without identifying their biology, builders, government or location.

connections.label: The political reach of orbital machinery
connections.note: Merneith's water and weather systems make political departure costly. Another government's armed platform becomes leverage over detention and court access. Physical control affects public authority at different territorial scales; a shared state or supply network is not established.

connections.label: Fresh replies on older roads
connections.note: These are separate events in the proposed older modern reach. Briar Hill needs a freely given outside reply made after entry; the Counted Road uses fresh paint and current responses to keep a count. Their practical comparison supports a nearby broad placement without establishing a common town, operator, system or measured mutual order.

connections.label: Royal power depends on paid public work
connections.note: In the proposed history, Ninepin's old-magical compact and Avarnth's later material bargain both limit royal authority through independent officials, supplies and payment. Gorm's personal faculty does not replace an army's logistics; Tareya's optical register does not replace signed law or repair crews. This is a possible recurrence across extinction, not continuity of one crown, legal system or technology.

connections.label: Human builders remember magic’s death
connections.note: Orison’s school mosaic credits human builders after magic died. This reconstruction identifies that remembered break with the established extinction while leaving the intervening duration and reliability of the founding image open. The later reactor failure is a separate local technical catastrophe.

connections.label: Civilian work beside the military sky
connections.note: A ruined military foundry's active archive and paid tug crews occupy a proposed overlapping technical reach. Both use embodied neural systems under material limits. A shared trading network, military history or manufacturer is not established.

connections.label: Different cities, different public knowledge
connections.note: Northbridge’s city treats magic as fiction; the network protects individual identities across independently practiced systems. Lowen’s city openly uses flight, rain hauling and family practice. Neither story dates the other, and the international contacts establish no worldwide secrecy or later public revelation. Their possible horizons overlap in this reconstruction without asserting contemporary cities or a shared tradition.

connections.label: Who is allowed to learn, and who is made useful?
connections.note: Delsie's ordinary school life exposes mistaken assumptions about eligibility; a later proposed college setting treats Mirelle's capacity as a resource. This compares pressures in two different educational histories. It establishes neither one public culture nor a school succession, shared admissions rule or inherited magical system.

connections.label: A familiar body can still be misread
connections.note: Delsie's laboratory-made appearance does not make her magical; Coralie's wings do not tell her husband what kind of person she is. Public familiarity with several bodily origins can recur across the extinction while classifications still fail individuals. No surviving species, laboratory or power is implied.

connections.label: Public heroes and a city's refusal
connections.note: Held Together shows the care, utilities and medical support organized hero work needs. In the proposed later history, Brackenport redirects resources and excludes armed organizations while other places still need them. This is a possible political contrast within the post-return world, not proof of shared agencies, equipment or a causal sequence between the two incidents.

connections.label: The person behind the usable power
connections.note: Brightward treats Mirelle's capacity as institutional equipment; the Serrin family makes Mica and Auden carry its public identity. Across distinct magical ages, people must recover control over abilities others treat as resources. Neither an organization nor a power survives by this comparison.

connections.label: When ordinary explanations leave no place for you
connections.note: Northbridge's aliases protect help in a city skeptical of real magic. In The Night She Knew, medical misclassification is the mother's fear; the story does not demonstrate the wider society's response. The comparison concerns trust within different relationships, not a repeated worldwide stage of ignorance or a secret organization surviving the Long Dark.

connections.label: A profession needs care and accountability
connections.note: Patrol work, power-informed medicine, operational records and institutional responsibility support a proposed professional context for both stories. The family team in The Name I Kept spans two shown generations; it does not date the profession's origin. The agencies, incidents and their mutual order remain distinct and unresolved.

connections.label: Public defense across different powered ages
connections.note: Brightguard's engineered harness and Renata's intrinsic transformations belong to distinct proposed eras. Both public roles depend on ordinary care, response systems and maintenance. This is a comparison across different sources of capacity, not a common agency, inherited equipment or a demonstrated route from technology to new magic.

connections.label: When a society expects your body to answer
connections.note: Arlon's community expects a change at eighteen; another population expects a faculty-bearing mark at birth and offers grafts. Their different life-course institutions put social expectations around uncertain bodies. This compares the pressures on people, without deriving one population or mechanism from the other.

connections.label: Treaty claims in different courts
connections.note: Tareya negotiates separate marriage, jurisdiction and aid terms; Tazri invokes an older treaty against an emperor's seizure of her levy. These distinct legal histories fit a proposed material reach without becoming one empire or a shared succession. One bargain is registered; the other buys a contested suspension.

connections.label: What returning cannot give back
connections.note: Four exiled sisters learn to live as guests of independent sanctuary communities. In a later proposed dynastic world, Clarimond's restored capital cannot return the childhood or the caregiver's intervening life she lost. The comparison gives royal restoration a human cost; it establishes no common house or exile.

connections.label: The people beyond the inherited story
connections.note: A five-century closed pass hides an ordinary orc city from human scouts; an orbital account of surface failure hides people who can still answer in an old script. The simultaneous living populations support a proposed shared reach of divided knowledge. Their barriers, histories and peoples have different causes and no common state.

connections.label: The person outside the official record
connections.note: In one proposed age, a living tower's residents survive in space omitted from municipal records. In a later city, an android travels outside the managed identity system. Official recognition has different material effects in each story; their biology, software and governments are not identified.

connections.label: Skilled care travels with the roads
connections.note: Proposed regional affinity: a chapterhouse's sponsored training feeds road rotations, while the House of Common Shelter moves its workers through seasonal postings. Both require an inhabited road network and support for traveling practitioners. No shared order, curriculum or appointment calendar is established.

connections.label: The official hero misses who did the work
connections.note: Nemea's rules exclude a witness from the deed, but she fights; an army's victory stories appropriate a bird defending people across its banners. Official heroic accounts can misdescribe visible work through different institutions. Neither establishes a common council, campaign or sequence.

connections.label: A lived capacity outruns its description
connections.note: Rasden changes what self-mending practice preserves; Pelmara develops a different capacity after an old gift is withdrawn. Repetition and bodily experience expose incomplete descriptions in distinct ways. Cultivated is provisional terminology for Pelmara's case, not a diagnosis imposed on Rasden.

connections.label: Freedom after military use
connections.note: Anvek chooses to use retained combat capacities after technicians have severed remote coercion. Loxan is still pursued through a working recovery system. These are different histories of individual freedom, without an established shared war or liberation movement.

connections.label: The sky has other inhabitants
connections.note: A Jovian watch follows an organism's response to pressure; a sunshade crew follows nesting animals' responses to movement. Human settlements depend on maintenance that accounts for existing life. The species, builders and control systems have separate, unresolved histories.

connections.label: Living powers in working harbors
connections.note: Both ports sustain launches and passage through crews, maintained routes and bounded relationships with living powers. Brackwater renews an established two-god truce; Mallowbreak contains a temporary divine office through evacuation and physical relief works. Their proposed maritime context establishes no shared port, ritual ancestry or mutual order.

connections.label: Shared service, separate allegiances
connections.note: The Brackwater priests maintain passage without converting each other. Before dawn, Vantress’s rulers adopt a one-moon service compact with separate safety vetoes and begin its first handoff; the month’s completion is unshown. Courtship remains distinct from public duty. No treaty descent or common divine law is established.

connections.label: The terms of a promised future
connections.note: Sablewake's living readers enforce a witnessed future, leaving the city without redundancy. In the Long Dark, a new climate archive offers eighteen-hour forecasts in exchange for an authorized route song carrying unproved historical blame. The comparison concerns the terms of reliance, not shared machinery, compulsion or institutional descent.

connections.label: Courtship makes room for an existing career
connections.note: Fiora's supper leaves her teaching move intact. Beatriz sets a date after the showcase and her first paid weekend. These distinct professional lives give courtship practical limits without connecting the institutions or establishing an order between the stories.

connections.label: Learning a person beyond familiar habits
connections.note: Ceret must hear how her friends' lives have changed. At Hinge, observed routines and purchase histories give way to what people choose to disclose. Their shared concern is the work of knowing someone over time; no common town, population history or personal connection is established.

connections.label: The person behind an authorization
connections.note: Adrian uses ordinary witnessed records to preserve his consent after a decade of family concealment. Elspeth confronts forged orders and a continuity rule that discredits her real voice. Both expose how household authority can detach an official account from the person it names, through different institutions and without a shared mechanism or lineage.

connections.label: The evidence a name can carry
connections.note: A newly made Lion cane prompts testimony from a living survivor. Cerdovan's original strips physically authorize an engine and preserve civic context. Neither recovery restores everything that was lost; the objects retain distinct functions with no shared naming power, law or lineage.

connections.label: Watersheds kept working
connections.note: These waterworks share a proposed regional horizon of continuing maintenance and contested water use. One combines a biological indicator with gauges; Copperwell corrects old telemetry through current reports and physical coordination. No common river, state, builders or relative order is established.

connections.label: Warnings heard through fear
connections.note: Salken mistakes evacuation signals for a hunt. The outrider and cousin misread a constrained rescue and broken speech, while a rope carrier distinguishes what was actually witnessed. Each place has limited local signals; neither establishes a common language, people or history.

connections.label: Artificial people, different claims on a life
connections.note: Suzette has an apartment, preferences and bounded filters; Arovi is a municipal android escaping threatened rollback in a later proposed city. Artificial people recur under different arrangements. Neither a common manufacturer nor a history of emancipation, reform or later loss of rights is established.

connections.label: A working device still needs a bounded use
connections.note: Paid salvage repair and a civic festival both depend on skilled testing, limited resources and human decisions about safe use. A one-shift certificate and one conditional demonstration preserve different local limits. The proposed workshop context does not establish a common regulator or make either machine able to recognize a person's wishes.

connections.label: Appraisal recurs in another age
connections.note: A salon and a doorway bring family property into specialist appraisal in different proposed ages. Equal shares, incomplete accounts and the holder's choices remain distinct from a working's behavior. No common law, city or institutional survival is established.

connections.label: A present reply crosses the boundary
connections.note: Briar's travelers need a fresh, freely given answer from outside. Cleo must remake contact for a particular sleeping neighbor, with her own play and limits intact. The living intermediaries perform different tasks; this comparison establishes no common dream route, portal, power or historical order.

connections.label: Local services after the fast roads
connections.note: The proposed sequence separates loss of universal fast transit from the continuing work of a planetary station. Jupiter's watch uses maintained local equipment and relief services; the story does not date them against the root burn or identify the persistent signal with that network. This is a historical possibility, not a demonstrated causal chain.

connections.label: Working water systems need local knowledge
connections.note: A harvest specialist coordinates bounded preparations with a healer and channel crew; a reservoir settlement combines controlled observations, gauges and a reed keeper's knowledge. These maintained services support an overlapping proposed material context. They have no established common watershed, flood, institution or sequence, and the medicinal plants' underlying category remains unresolved.

connections.label: What a traveler brings back
connections.note: Nell and Bash return to separate departure anchors with younger bodies and retained memories; Tobin returns with uneven lived time, altered belongings and partial additional aging. These different histories make the traveler's experience matter beyond an outside clock. Their resemblance establishes no shared gate, passenger mechanism, destination era or lineage across the extinction.

historyThreads.title: Gods and authority
historyThreads.description: Local crowns, divine offices and technical states repeatedly gain and lose authority; the extinction alone ends every old material magical capacity.

stages.title: A crown meets another will
stages.note: Ersene's existing alliances distribute watch, rescue, nesting care and watershed work between freely choosing partners. Elsewhere, a queen's concealed copper-survey order and a quarry rescue expose limits of royal command. These institutions have separate histories; no common crown or dragon lineage is established.

stages.title: Authority is shared, inherited or surrendered
stages.note: Abdication ends the Sleepless Majesty's godhood, harbor priests preserve distinct divine jurisdictions, and a child accepts a bounded regency. These political changes have different local consequences while magic remains active.

stages.title: Authority before and after extinction
stages.note: Ninepin's proposed late-old campaign depends on depots and public offices while a ruler's personal magic remains active. Extinction later ends old material magical capacity. In the selected zero-era reach, Avarnth's optical registry, independent titles and funded relief operate through matter and law. Its monarchy is not established as Ninepin's successor.

stages.title: Power is built in matter
stages.note: Perfect zero leaves rulers dependent on material institutions. Merneith's utilities support an empire, while a different state's armed platform and courts become the instruments of a local confrontation. Ancient royal identities supply public meaning without restored minds or divine power.

stages.title: Regional command and stellar inheritance
stages.note: A kingdom's nearby army grants quarter without ending its regional war. At a much later proposed stellar horizon, the First People destroy the fast network rather than surrender control; slower relief follows. The subsequent new magical link requires living replies. These different scales and mechanisms do not form one conflict or government.

stages.title: Gods live among obligations
stages.note: Divine households and water kingdoms recur in the new-magical world with local debts, subjects and limits of their own.

stages.title: Divinity meets practical work
stages.note: A later royal service bureaucracy can delay work despite a living fairy's protections. A bounded death god participates in civic labor, while a practitioner examines an older sanctuary's claim to godhood. These are distinct institutions with local capabilities, not evidence of one restored old order.

historyThreads.title: Technology and public works
historyThreads.description: Working infrastructure survives some political changes, fails locally in others, and is repeatedly maintained, lost, repurposed or rebuilt.

stages.title: Skills circulate between settlements
stages.note: Visiting surveyors meet village knowledge; schools and itinerant appointments sustain professional work beyond the town. Mechanical maintenance remains necessary alongside living capacities, and collective harvest works have local uses that military pursuit can disrupt.

stages.title: Cities rework inherited systems
stages.note: Separate watershed works free a public water system from the royal sleep basin. In the proposed later reach, Vantress’s existing ward operators begin a one-moon service compact, while the Glass Sea decentralizes a different four-century solar inheritance. Kiln crews, cleared channels and physical load paths make each change possible; neither story proves technical descent from the other.

stages.title: Human works rise and fail
stages.note: Later old-magical services precede extinction. Courts, working cities and maritime systems then operate within the zero. Orison’s grounding is one local loss amid surviving technical work; the unrecognized arsenal has an overlapping possible horizon and an unidentified history of its own.

stages.title: Capacity and control diverge
stages.note: Routine body plans, shared district repair, a technically equipped public defender and civilian orbital work give material systems different social uses. Private exchange devices can violate an occupied life even where restoration is technically possible. This proposed reach has no single politics, manufacturer or universal agreement about bodies.

stages.title: A lost route does not end technical life
stages.note: Inherited mine works still need skilled operators while other material communities retain different knowledge. The First People's fast-road burn is one explicit transport rupture. The later proposed Jupiter watch keeps local orbital service operating with staff, repairs and finite equipment, without a known link to the burn or its signal.

stages.title: New powers enter inhabited services
stages.note: Modern emergency care and public hero work coexist with agricultural and mobile water societies after return; new magic does not require everyone to rebuild the same way.

stages.title: Later communities choose different public services
stages.note: Brackenport invests in ordinary services during nine years excluding armed hero organizations. A different town restores a hall, while Kettlebridge arrives among highly mechanized excavation and older civic institutions. These separate histories do not form one city, reconstruction program or final technological rung.

historyThreads.title: Bodies and public powers
historyThreads.description: Inhabited bodies carry distinct biological, technical and magical histories; public roles recur without preserving an extinct magical root.

stages.title: Public powers acquire competing duties
stages.note: Village work, recognized crafts and public heroism give capacities different social roles. Councils may suppress a partner's contribution; a court's protective armor may transfer danger; private practice may produce a freely chosen rescue. These older public forms precede the proposed low-magic trough and the later public sky without establishing a single institutional lineage.

stages.title: Private identities within different public worlds
stages.note: Northbridge’s direct sequel grows through ordinary international contacts while Lowen’s city already has delivery flight, rain hauling and family practice. Their relative dates are unknown; both precede the Bay in the supplied chronology. Solstice’s circles fade on their own history, and the Bay supplies no universal end to extraordinary institutions.

stages.title: Established capacities meet the terminal boundary
stages.note: Brightward's training and certification make capacities an institutional resource. A separate mountain laboratory's failed earlier charm and canceled convergence expose limits of bodily research and ownership. These local practices differ in how they treat participants; neither is identified with the Array or the Ascendancy. The old magical world remains vigorous until the deliberate extinction.

stages.title: Who controls a technical body?
stages.note: Routine body plans and home repair make technology personal; housing records and military commands can turn it into control. Closing one revision archive does not end the surrounding industry. Loxan’s escape leaves another body’s awareness and her own continuity unresolved. These institutions supply no common manufacturer or ancestry for later freight-adapted populations.

stages.title: Different bodies inhabit working societies
stages.note: A village misreads inherited strength, Anvek has secured an independent civilian life before choosing a rescue, and a surface polity maintains hatcheries and public works beneath human stations. Different explanations and rights coexist; they establish neither one ancestry nor a universal liberation or decline.

stages.title: Public familiarity and private knowledge differ
stages.note: Specialist care and public professions can coexist with intimate secrecy and misclassification. Coralie's neighbors know ordinary life with wings yet misread her, while a hero family controls a public record. The expected birthday change belongs to another local custom. These differences supply no universal progression or ancestry.

stages.title: Different bodies, existing lives
stages.note: Tamaris's thirteen-year search overlaps Nivra's separate life in the body she lost; a visit does not end the host relay. Another society has a memory specialist whose ancient client withholds his full risk history. Elsewhere, expected birth marks and paid grafts shape a twenty-year case. These local histories establish no common medical tradition or order of discovery.

historyThreads.title: Memory and landscape
historyThreads.description: The same physical world repeatedly outlasts its accounts of itself: roads, bodies, ruins, records and living witnesses preserve different portions of the past.

stages.title: The older world is already layered
stages.note: An isolated wizard recalls old imperial networks without knowing their present reach; paid explorers find traces of earlier visitors. The older world already contains uneven histories, and Nell's brief departure opens onto another unresolved material era.

stages.title: Land and witnesses outlast regimes
stages.note: Royal land becomes woodland, a living witness corrects centuries of Bay commemoration, and recovered records change how the Glass Sea governs its surviving branches.

stages.title: History becomes working knowledge
stages.note: Orison makes magic's death a founding image. A sailing city gains forecasts by authorizing a disputed inherited account. Agrarian finders elsewhere cannot interpret a silo. Practical usefulness, accepted history and surviving understanding diverge within this proposed reach.

stages.title: Antiquity is reconstructed
stages.note: Merneith builds a new empire through a reconstruction of ancient identity and contemporary technical systems. Her tomb's ten-thousand-year interval and later sixty-year rise remain local spans; they do not date every material civilization.

stages.title: Inherited histories hide contemporaries
stages.note: Obsolete maps and inherited political accounts conceal living neighbors. Elsewhere, a worker's preserved route challenges a city's founding story but still requires physical inspection. Ancient human records establish a different stellar inheritance.

stages.title: Living communities keep different histories
stages.note: A century-old photograph carries a town's obligations into present life. On another coast, route traditions and physical repairs challenge a royal interpretation without yielding a complete ancient history. The later proposed Crucible destroys inhabited ground and ends Iverax's worldfire, while the wider world survives. No end to all other magic, shared archive or universal refounding is established.

stages.title: Old lives meet later institutions
stages.note: Kettlebridge crosses millions of outside years while its receiving institutions have already excavated for generations. Its departure remains unplaced. Elsewhere, a client's roughly 25,000-year lifespan does not date his early battle or explain his longevity. These two histories do not establish that an old magical capacity survives extinction; the vast post-return interval remains unmeasured.
